questions.q: In how many different ways can the letters of the word LETTER be arranged?
questions.why: 6 letters with repeats: 6! ÷ 2! ÷ 2! = 180. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 110 people, 73 like cricket, 50 like football and 24 like neither. How many like only cricket?
questions.why: Both = 73 + 50 − (110 − 24) = 37; only cricket = 73 − 37 = 36. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Pointing to a man, Deepak said, "His only brother is the father of my daughter." How is the man related to Deepak?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 5:15?
In a row of 48 students, Ajay is 19th from the left and Anil is 15th from the right. How many students sit between them?
If 14 January 2026 was a Wednesday, what day of the week was 20 April 2026?
questions.why: 96 days later; 96 mod 7 = 5, so count 5 days on from Wednesday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Ajay is the son of Sunil. Anil is the daughter of Sunil. Rekha is the husband of Anil. How is Rekha related to Ajay?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The words Record, Recount, Receipt, Recall and Recent are arranged as in a dictionary. Which word comes third?
questions.why: The order is Recall, Receipt, Recent, Record, Recount.

questions.q: Each letter is given its position in the alphabet (A = 1, B = 2, and so on) and a word's value is the sum of its letters, so GOA = 7 + 15 + 1 = 23. What is the value of PANAJI?
The present ages of Vijay and Rekha are in the ratio 2 : 5. After 10 years the ratio will be 8 : 15. What is Rekha's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 2k and 5k: (2k + 10)/(5k + 10) = 8/15 gives k = 7, so Rekha is 35. GPSC-style practice item.
